title: Differentiation of human induced-pluripotent stem cells into smooth muscle cells
protocol: Add 1 g of bovine serum albumin (BSA) to 1000 mL PBS and filter with a 0.2 μm filter.
Weigh 50 mg of collagenase type B and add it to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 50 ml of warm DMEM to dissolve the collagenase type B to obtain a final concentration of 1 mg/mL.
Store collagenase B solution at 4°C for up to 2 weeks.
Weigh 50 mg of collagenase type IV and add it to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 50 ml of warm DMEM to dissolve the collagenase type IV to obtain a final concentration of 1 mg/mL.
Store collagenase IV solution at 4°C for up to 2 weeks.

Add 400 mL KO-DMEM to 100 mL FBS, 5 mL non essential amino acids, 2.5 mL 200 mM L-glutamine, 1 mL 50 mM β-mercaptoethanol (final concentration of 0.1 mM), and 2.5 mL streptomycin:penicillin to prepare EBs medium.
Autoclave a solution made by adding 1 g of gelatin to 1000 mL MilliQ water at 121°C, 15 psi for 30 min.
Add 0.1% (w/v) gelatin solution to cover the surfaces of cell culture wells and incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Prepare DMEM-F12 medium by mixing the required volumes and supplements as directed.
Supplement prepared medium with β-FGF before use.
Filtrate MACS buffer solution after preparation.
Dissolve PDGF_BB in 1 mL of 0.1% (w/v) BSA to make a 10 µg/mL solution.
Prepare aliquots of the PDGF_BB solution and store at -80°C for up to 6 months.
Dilute 0.5% trypsin-EDTA solution in PBS to obtain a 0.1% (v/v) solution.
Prepare aliquots of the trypsin-EDTA solution and store at -20°C.
Reconstitute β-FGF with 0.1% (w/v) BSA.
Dissolve 10 μg of β-FGF in 1 ml of the BSA solution.
Add 39 μL of β-mercaptoethanol to 10 mL of PBS.
Mix thoroughly to prepare the β-mercaptoethanol solution.
Transfer cryopreserved vials containing mitomycin-inactivated CF-1 MEFs from a 37°C water bath to a 15 mL conical tube with 4 mL of DMEM medium (for MEFs).
Centrifuge the cells for 3 min at 300 × g, room temperature.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in DMEM medium (for MEFs).
Plate the cells at a density between 7 × 10^4/cm^2 and 8 × 10^4/cm^2 into a 100 mm diameter Petri dish coated with gelatin (0.1%).
Incubate the cells for at least 24 h before plating the iPSCs.
Transfer cryopreserved vials containing iPSC in a 37°C water bath to a 15 mL conical tube immediately after thawing.
Centrifuge the cells for 3 minutes at 200 × g, room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet in iPSC medium supplemented with 10 ng/mL β-FGF.
Plate the cells into previously prepared mitomycin-inactivated CF-1 MEFs using approximately 10 ml of medium per plate.
Passage iPSC cultures every 3-5 days using collagenase type IV solution (1 mg/mL).
Aspirate the medium when iPSC cultures reach 80% confluency.
Add 4 mL of 1 mg/mL collagenase type IV solution to each petri dish.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 37°C until colonies start to detach from boundaries.
Aspirate the collagenase type IV solution.
Add 4 mL of iPSC medium supplemented with 10 ng/mL β-FGF per petri dish.
Scrape cells using a 5 mL sterile plastic pipette.
Transfer contents of each petri dish to a 50 mL conical tube and dilute four times in iPSC medium.
Wash each petri dish with 4 mL of medium and transfer the wash to the same 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the iPSCs for 3 minutes at 200 × g, room temperature.
Resuspend pelleted colonies in iPSC medium at a ratio of 1:3 or 1:4.
Aspirate the medium from Petri dishes containing recently prepared mitomycin-inactivated MEFs.
Add 5 mL of iPSC medium per petri dish.
Culture iPSCs on 100 mm petri dishes until they reach 80% confluence.
Aspirate the medium and add 6 mL of 1 mg/ml type IV collagenase for 2 h at 37°C.
Add 6 mL of iPSC medium to detached cell aggregates, pipette up and down a few times.
Pool the undifferentiated iPSC aggregates (approximately 2 petri dishes per 50 mL conical tube).
Centrifuge pooled aggregates 3 min at 200 × g, room temperature.
Carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant, then add 6 ml of iPSC medium supplemented with 10 ng/mL β-FGF.
Transfer undifferentiated iPSC aggregates (ratio of 2:1) to 100 mm low attachment plates containing 10 mL of EB medium.
Every 2 days over a period of 10 days, transfer the cell culture medium containing EBs to a 15-mL conical tube.
Let EBs settle by gravity and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the EBs in fresh differentiation medium (10 mL) and re-plate in the same low-attachment 100 mm petri dish.
After 10 days in suspension, isolate CD34+ cells by MACS.
Dissociate EBs with collagenase B (1 mg/mL) for 2 h at 37°C.
Agitate periodically.
Resuspend cells using a 10 mL sterile pipette to separate aggregates.
Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 800 rpm.
Wash cells with 5 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge again.
Pass cells through a cell strainer (40 μm pore size).
Wash the strainer twice with 2 mL of EBs medium and quantify cell number.
Centrifuge the cells for 3 minutes at 200 × g, room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in MACs buffer according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Add 100 μL of FcR Blocking Reagent to up to 10^8 cells.
Add 100 μL of CD34 MicroBeads for up to 10^8 cells.
Mix well and incubate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator (2–8°C).
Wash the cells by adding 1x 10 mL of MACS buffer for up to 10^8 cells.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend in 500 μL of MACS buffer (up to 10^8 cells).
Filter through a cell strainer (40 μm pore size) if necessary.
Prime the LS column by rinsing with 3 mL of MACS buffer and discard the effluent.
Apply the cell suspension onto the LS column and collect the flow-through containing the unlabeled cells (CD34− cells).
Wash the LS column three times with 3 mL of MACS buffer, discarding each wash.
Remove the column from the separator and place it over a new collection tube.
Pipette 5 mL of EGM-2 medium onto the LS column to flush out magnetically labeled cells (CD34+ cells).
Prime a MS column with 500 μL of MACS buffer and discard the effluent.
Wash the MS column three times with 500 μL of MACS buffer, discarding each wash.
Resuspend eluted CD34+ cells in 1 mL of EGM-2 medium.
Count purified CD34+ fraction using a hemocytometer.
Change the medium 24 hours after cell seeding.
Replace the medium every other day thereafter.
Aspirate the cell culture medium when cells reach confluency.
Wash the cells with 500 µL PBS per well.
Add 500 µL of 0.1% (v/v) trypsin-EDTA to cover the monolayer.
Incubate for 3 minutes at 37°C until cells start detaching.
Transfer the content to a 15 mL conical tube with 2 mL EGM-2 medium.
Centrifuge the tube for 2 minutes at 300 × g, room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of EGM-2 medium.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed the cells at a density of 3´10^4 cells/cm² in EGM-2 medium supplemented with PDGF_BB (50 ng/mL).
Maintain the cells in EGM-2 medium supplemented with PDGF_BB until passage 4.
Replace the medium with SmGM-2 after 4 passages.
